sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text:
The Endings system in Escape from Tarkov represents the final progression stage within the game's storyline, allowing players to reach one of four endings based on their decisions throughout the story chapters. The endings reflect different allegiances, moral choices and outcomes for the player's PMC, marking the conclusion of their journey in Tarkov. Each ending comes with a special dogtag, armband, achievement, hideout customization, main menu background and an icon shown in the player profile.

If you plan to pursue a specific ending, take time to study each route carefully and review all related information before committing to your decisions. Once completed, there is no rewind button, all choices are final. It is possible to experience all four endings by resetting your game profile or through the Prestige system.

sections.heading: Savior
sections.text: "Escaped from Tarkov – For Humanity: You placed your trust in Kerman — and that step was far beyond the mere instinct to survive. The strike against TerraGroup tore apart their veil of deceit: secrets were laid bare, corrupt politicians lost their power, and humanity woke up. The world cast off its chains and, for the first time, breathed free of TerraGroup’s control — realizing it could live differently and halt its own descent into ruin. Yes, you escaped from Tarkov. But with you, the truth broke free as well — a rare beam of light cutting through the darkness. It will not erase the scars nor heal the pain, but it will lay a new foundation for reason and humanism. You escaped from Tarkov for the sake of humanity. For the sake of all of us."

sections.heading: Debtor
sections.text: "Escaped from Tarkov – but Didn't Escape From Yourself: You nearly touched the truth, but you froze halfway. The evidence was in your hands, and yet you withdrew — calling it caution. Kerman remembered you as unreliable. Everything you had uncovered dissolved into the din of headlines and the swelling chaos, as though it had never existed. TerraGroup did not merely survive — they grew stronger. People began to look up to them as though to a lone savior of mankind. And still, you believed you had saved yourself. Yet by letting go of the truth, you made their victory absolute. Now you remain nothing more than a mercenary without honor, bound by a debt to Lightkeeper that weighs upon you like a stone on the heart. You managed to escape, but you could not escape from your Tarkov. You could not escape from yourself."

sections.heading: Survivor
sections.text: "Escaped from Tarkov – And Survived: You ran for the sake of survival. You chose the path of a runaway, not a seeker of truth. You thought all would end once you left the cursed city. But behind you, Tarkov erupted in flames. You never saw the whole picture. Never realized that your step was a link in the chain that doomed the city. And in that moment, while the ashes had yet to settle, TerraGroup rose from the ruins — as if they had awaited this very hour. The world fell to its knees before them, and you were left with nothing. Alive, yet hollow. Saved, yet branded by guilt. You survived. But at what cost?"

sections.heading: Fallen
sections.text: "Escaped from Tarkov – To Fall in the Darkness: You did not trust him. Suspicion felt like a safeguard to you, yet at its core was only fear. Tarkov had fallen, but that was merely the prologue to disaster. From every corner of the world came reports: people massively losing their minds, fading within weeks. No one understood the nature of this affliction, yet every new madness echoed the weight of your choice. Upon the ruins of chaos, TerraGroup rose as a false savior. And yet, it was they who had birthed this catastrophe. You, too, became one of those who lent strength to their ascent. You believed that caution would keep you safe, but your escape only led to a fall — into the darkness, with no hope of return."
